verdict.rationale: Founder Law publishes a dedicated pricing page built around flat-fee packages: "One flat fee. Everything included." Packages are tiered by visa category (EB-1A/EB-2 NIW; O-1A/H-1B/L-1/E-3/TN), state their inclusions (government fees, premium processing, RFE/NOID defense), add dependents at a "standardized, flat rate," and promise to quote out-of-package costs upfront. However, no actual dollar amounts appear anywhere in the evidence, so it cannot be confirmed that a founder sees real prices without first contacting the firm. Missing for 10: published dollar figures for packages, dependents and the strategy session; independent or hands-on confirmation that prices are visible without a consultation.
